verses.pali: “Tayome, bhikkhave, bhavā pahātabbā, tīsu sikkhāsu sikkhitabbaṁ.
verses.english: “Mendicants, you should give up these three states of existence. And you should train in three trainings.
What are the three states of existence you should give up?
Existence in the sensual realm, the realm of luminous form, and the formless realm.
These are the three states of existence you should give up.
What are the three trainings you should train in?
The training in the higher ethics, the higher mind, and the higher wisdom.
These are the three trainings you should train in.

verses.pali: Yato kho, bhikkhave, bhikkhuno ime tayo bhavā pahīnā honti, imāsu ca tīsu sikkhāsu sikkhitasikkho hoti—
verses.english: When a mendicant has given up these three states of existence and has trained in these three trainings

verses.pali: ayaṁ vuccati, bhikkhave, bhikkhu acchecchi taṇhaṁ, vivattayi saṁyojanaṁ, sammā mānābhisamayā antamakāsi dukkhassā”ti.
verses.english: they’re called a mendicant who has cut off craving, cast off the fetters, and by rightly comprehending conceit has made an end of suffering.”
